soft: {branch} goes back to {sha}; the changes stay staged.
mixed: {branch} goes back to {sha}; your files stay as they are.
keep: {branch} and its files go back to {sha}.
changed: Something has changed since, so it cannot be undone from here.
detached: HEAD was not on a branch before.
localChanges: Your local changes are in the files it would change. Commit, stash or discard them, then undo.
